{{Top}}
The '''guided missile''' was a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] that could be remotely fired, normally from a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. The guided missile however had a short lifetime and burned itself out after a period of time.

These missiles were typically fired by a co-pilot in starfighters. These missiles were sometimes used in [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]]. The missile could inflict a great deal of damage upon its target, and would nearly always kill foot soldiers. The missile was commonly pink when in flight. The missile was fired out of the co-pilot's section of the TIE bomber.
